fact: The Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications laid the first stone at Adjelon, Evinayong, for telephone antennas, the start of a government plan to extend the mobile network to newly opened districts including Akok Esabok, Mbomo and Demu.
title: Puesta de primera piedra en Adjelon para extender la red móvil a los nuevos distritos urbanos
publisher: Oficina de Información y Prensa de Guinea Ecuatorial
